summary: Iter16 re-verified the two frontend blockers from iter15 plus the photo gallery. All three cases PASS on web preview. (1) /api/admin/ui: on fresh load fieldsModal and docModal have computed display:none (fix `.hidden{display:none!important}` at admin_web.py:142) — login screen visible, Connect with jobby-admin-7c2f9a works, Categories tab shows Driver row (2 fields), 'Fields' opens the editor, adding iter16_note + IT/EN labels + Save persists; reopening shows the new field and Driver row updates to '3 fields'; ✕ closes the modal. (2) Client cancel on web: with session token jobby_session_token=JSON.stringify('demo-preview-token-123') in localStorage (RN AsyncStorage v2.2 web uses window.localStorage directly), Richieste tab renders cancel-mission-* and cancel-biz-* buttons. New Platform.OS==='web' branch in richieste.tsx:77-86 fires window.confirm — clicking cancel-biz-breq_f9a7b7ca6fad flipped status pending→cancelled, cancel-mission-msn_7627bb7003af flipped matched→cancelled (verified via GET /api/business-requests and /api/requests). (3) Photo gallery: /business-request/user_2f996c8a010a renders biz-photo-0 and biz-photo-1 (seeded 1x1 PNG data URLs) plus the price_list (Camicia €2.50, Pantalone €1.80). No React Native red screens; only benign warnings about deprecated shadow* / pointerEvents style props.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' across the app. Non-blocking on RN 0.7x but should be migrated. Ref: multiple screens using shadow.* from /app/frontend/src/theme.ts.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Old seeded/cancelled TEST_iter15 items still show under Requests -> Completed; safe to leave.
(Nit) Migrate `shadow.card` etc. to `boxShadow` style, and `pointerEvents` prop to `style.pointerEvents`, to silence RN 0.75+ web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_web.py:142 fix is minimal & correct (`.hidden{display:none!important}`). Consider replacing inline `display:flex` on the two modals with a `.modal-open` class toggled by JS to avoid future collisions.

richieste.tsx cancel handlers now correctly branch on Platform.OS==='web' with window.confirm — clean, idiomatic fix. Same pattern should be reused for any other destructive Alert.alert flows in the app.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 blockers cleared: admin modal, cancel on web, photo gallery)

seed_data_creation: None (used existing pending mission msn_7627bb7003af and biz request breq_f9a7b7ca6fad; both now cancelled).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iter15 frontend blockers are fixed and verified end-to-end on the live preview URL. RN AsyncStorage v2.2 on web uses window.localStorage — to inject test session set `localStorage.setItem('jobby_session_token', JSON.stringify('demo-preview-token-123'))` and reload. To bypass the new window.confirm dialog in Playwright, pre-set `window.confirm = () => true` before clicking cancel buttons (Playwright's dialog auto-accept handler can race with the click). Photos for user_2f996c8a010a are seeded as 1x1 base64 PNGs — good enough to exercise the gallery UI but visually pixel-sized; if a demo screenshot is needed, seed real photo URLs.
rca_of_issue: N/A — both iter15 root-cause fixes verified: (a) `.hidden{display:none!important}` in admin_web.py overrides the inline `display:flex` on the two overlay divs so the modals stay hidden on load, and (b) the new `confirmCancel` helper in richieste.tsx uses `window.confirm` on web (which RN Web supports) and falls back to Alert.alert(buttons) on native — replacing the previous flow whose destructive-button onPress was dropped by react-native-web.
